headline: Oil Prices Hit Five-Month High of $110, Raising Consumer Pressures
summary: Global oil prices reached a five-month high of $110 a barrel, with Asian and Europe gas prices hitting multi-month highs and driving up everyday costs.
why: Crude oil is a vital global commodity whose price directly influences transportation costs, energy bills, and broad consumer price inflation.

impacts.name: Brent Crude
impacts.why: Surging commodity prices increase input costs for manufacturers and fuel costs for consumers worldwide.

why_moved: Supply tightness pushed crude oil benchmarks to $110 per barrel, triggering broad economic anxiety over escalating energy expenses.
